title: Hero Section
text: Section: About / Hero Name: Neeraj J Tagline: AI Enthusiast Bio: I'm a data engineer, software developer, and tech enthusiast with a Master’s in Data Science from Florida State University, passionate about bridging the gap between raw data and actionable insights. With expertise in machine learning, web development, data analytics, Python, SQL, AWS, and AI-powered solutions, I thrive on solving complex problems and building scalable, impactful applications. I enjoy working on big data processing, cloud computing, and predictive modeling to drive intelligent decision-making. Let’s connect and create something extraordinary! 🚀

title: Information Assistant & Writer — Tallahassee, Florida at Center for Ocean and Atmospheric Prediction Studies
text: Section: Work Experience Role: Information Assistant & Writer — Tallahassee, Florida Company: Center for Ocean and Atmospheric Prediction Studies Date: September 2024 – Present Description:At the Center for Ocean-Atmospheric Prediction Studies (COAPS) at Florida State University, I work as an Information Assistant and Data Analyst, developing scalable data and AI-driven systems that support oceanographic research workflows. I architected a production-grade RAG knowledge assistant using LangGraph and LangChain, integrating internal wikis, research databases, and unstructured documents into a vector search pipeline that enabled accurate natural language querying for over 50 researchers. I also engineered automated LLM-based reporting pipelines that transformed daily marine vessel records into structured summaries and trend reports, reducing manual reporting effort by 80%. In addition, I designed Python and SQL ETL pipelines processing more than 50,000 vessel records daily to power real-time dashboards and backend query systems with sub-second response times. I further modernized multiple production research websites by containerizing services with Docker, improving deployment consistency, accelerating data retrieval performance, and implementing LDAP-based access control for secure researcher access.

metadata.company: Center for Ocean and Atmospheric Prediction Studies

title: Data Engineer — Pune, India at Datamorphosis
text: Section: Work Experience Role: Data Engineer — Pune, India Company: Datamorphosis Date: January 2022 – July 2023 Description: At Datamorphosis, I worked as a Data Engineer building scalable data pipelines and analytics infrastructure. I developed PySpark ETL pipelines that ingested and transformed more than 500K records per processing cycle into AWS S3 and Snowflake, enabling efficient data storage and analysis. I orchestrated workflows using Apache Airflow, integrated AWS Glue transformations, and implemented Delta Lake for versioned data storage. Additionally, I supported experimentation workflows by modeling datasets in dbt and delivering insights through Tableau dashboards, while enforcing data governance with schema validation, RBAC policies, and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Data Analyst and Team Lead Intern — Pune, India at Geniobits Private LTD
text: Section: Work Experience Role: Data Analyst and Team Lead Intern — Pune, India Company: Geniobits Private LTD Date: May 2021 – December 2021 Description: During my internship at Geniobits, I developed an end-to-end machine learning pipeline to identify at-risk students using academic performance data. The solution included data ingestion, preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation, which reduced manual data preparation time by 60% and accelerated experimentation workflows across the team. I trained and optimized a PyTorch-based classification model using feature selection, cross-validation, and grid search hyperparameter tuning, achieving an F1 score of 0.82 in predicting student risk levels. To make the model accessible in production, I deployed it as a FastAPI service and built an interactive Streamlit dashboard that provided instructors with real-time risk predictions, SHAP-based model explainability, and prioritized intervention recommendations for individual students.
